developmentBacklogAdded.name: Inactive-detail tombstone cache
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Search engines repeatedly surface already filled/cancelled jobs, wasting verification time on the same dead detail pages.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Store a tombstone with source URL, inactive reason and checkedAt; suppress rediscovery for 14-30 days unless the source publication/update timestamp changes.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Physical-burden gate for side jobs
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Generic logistics/brigade discovery can rank jobs with lifting, scene handling or repetitive heavy work despite otherwise acceptable location and pay.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Extract lifting/manual-load/evening-weekend burden into structured fields and apply a strong penalty or exclusion before alerting, while keeping lighter driver/admin work eligible.
